process_config: process an OmegaConf config by resolving setup fields, git info, and creating experiment directories
read_config_from_file: read an OmegaConf config from a YAML file on the filesystem and return it as an immutable struct
dict_to_config: convert a Python dictionary into an OmegaConf config object for use with Hydra
to_dict: convert an OmegaConf config object back into a plain Python dictionary with resolved values
get_env_params_from_config: extract environment builder parameters from a config by removing the hydra target key
